title: Endpoint inputs after the selected base theta square
interpretation: The edition 0.90 graph is preserved. Three whole historical entries were discharged earlier. Three additional entries supply their endpoint assertions on every member of the original selected class. This leaves three independent endpoint inputs and six entries with broader reconstruction work.
scope_of_remaining_base_theta_work: The base-rank theorem uses the readings and rational tests only on the actual linked bundle at its base level. Building the geometric data, their lifts and class sums as required for common family existence remains upstream. On the second-pass restricted datum the two levels also have simultaneous target coordinates.

BASE_THETA_RATIONAL_TESTS.endpoint_statement: On every actual selected bundle, the same base tests at each lift read every rational input and every stored target basis vector in the specified embedded field.
BASE_THETA_RATIONAL_TESTS.broader_work: Construction of higher covers, prescribed phases, class sums and their spanning before linkage, including the geometric inputs to a family at the requested scales.

BASE_THETA_READINGS.endpoint_statement: On every actual selected bundle the base geometric theta lift has the prescribed analytic and coefficient readings on the same face and yields the BTH12 base square.
BASE_THETA_READINGS.broader_work: Construction of the geometric realization, fitted level and compatible local parameters and readings upstream of linkage.

GLOBAL_RETAINED_DEFECT.endpoint_statement: LinkIRR on the original common eventual selected family, for every index with one threshold per admitted family.
GLOBAL_RETAINED_DEFECT.broader_work: Integral genus, level conjugacy and compatible representation intertwiner in the transport theorem for arbitrary supplied Forms0 families.
